definition: To add more details to an idea, a plan, or a story so that it becomes fuller and clearer.
example: The first draft was only two pages, so she fleshed it out with examples and data.

conversation.speaker: A
conversation.line: My plan for the new project is still very short.

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.line: You need to flesh it out. Add the costs, the dates, and the people you need.

conversation.speaker: A
conversation.line: Good idea. I will flesh it out this weekend.

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.line: Then we can show it to the team on Monday.
